label: NCBI Taxonomy: taxid lookups for 109 slice taxa, retrieved 2026-10-31
bibliographic_citation: Schoch CL, Ciufo S, Domrachev M, et al. (2020) NCBI Taxonomy: a comprehensive update on curation, resources and tools. Database 2020:baaa062.
license: Public domain (U.S. Government work); see NCBI website and data usage policies

counts.description: slice taxa with an NCBI taxid

measurement_technique: E-utilities esearch on db=taxonomy with the scientific name ([Scientific Name] field, falling back to all names), then esummary to confirm name and rank.
role: NCBI Taxonomy identifier for the listed taxa
notes: Reptilia has no NCBI node; Crustacea (6657) was merged into Pancrustacea (197562); Proteolepas is absent. Canis familiaris resolves to Canis lupus familiaris (9615).
